prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1298
Claimant:
Beth Higgins
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
13 Apr 2024
Claim opened atfer a report that the insured vehicle was struck while turning left at an intersection. The claimant is
not represented by an attorney and is handling the claim directly.
27 Apr 2024
Spoke with the other driver, who confirmed a left-turn collision and said the claimant's vehicle came across the
oncoming lane. The other driver's account matches the scene description and is consistent with the damage reported
so far.
28 Apr 2024
Reviweed scene photos and two independent witness statements. Both witnesses describe the same sequence of
events, and both place the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of impact, as confirmed by the responding officer's
report.
28 Jun 2024
Inspected the vehicle. The front-quarter damage and the airbag deployment line up well with the reported impact
angle and speed. A few older scratches along the lower rear panel may predate this loss and have been noted for the
appraiser.
27 Jul 2024
Claimant reports a knee injury that required urgent care and then a longer course of physical therapy than is typical
for this type of injury. Medical records are being requested to confirm the treatment timeline and the diagnosis.
14 Aug 2024
Claimant's medical history shows a minor strain in the same knee several years ago, which healed fully according to
the prior provider's notes. The earlier episode does not appear to have required ongoing care, but it will be
considered when evaluating the current treatment.
23 Sep 2024
Claimant gave a follow-up statement adding a few small details about the moments before the collision, such as the
traffic signal color and the speed of the approaching car. The core account has not changed from the first report.
1 Dec 2024
A neighbor contacted the desk and stated the vehicle looked damaged a few weeks before the reported collision
date. The statement is being noted and will be checked against photos, repair estimates and the policy's coverage
history. The driver is named on the policy, and covearge is not in question at this stage.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
